objective: Qualify exact canonical Java method views and structural containment before an equal-access navigation quality campaign.
population: All production declarations of all16 original r6 cases, independent of query, stack, positive coverage, candidate pool or reference labels. Closure retained. No new model or reference reads.
mechanism: Existing pinned Temurin JDK11 Compiler Tree API; JavacTask.parse only, never analyze/generate/call; annotation processing disabled. Exact source UTF8 byte slices and SHA from compiler AST positions converted from UTF16. Class/method containment is syntax-bound; invocation, constructor and member-reference target names/arity remain unresolved syntactic observations.
coordinate_policy: UTF16 offsets from compiler, independently converted UTF8 offsets for canonical byte slicing; explicit physical CR/LF/CRLF line coordinates. Unicode escapes and compiler-debug line interpretation are not claimed bound to runtime coverage in this stage.
scope_policy: All production files accounted, parser/encoding failures and unavailable spans explicit. Abstract/interface declarations are not executable bodies. Nested/local/anonymous classes, overloads, constructors and lambda-associated calls remain distinct. Complete method source may be too large for8K; no truncation is relabeled complete.
gate: Full16 case/source denominator, every indexed source identity matches canonical receipt, all emitted complete spans bind exact original UTF8 bytes, every class/method declaration span required complete; no silently discarded parse errors/unavailable spans. Compiler reference nodes lacking positions (including implicit enum construction) remain explicit unavailable-source-position and are NOT admissible source references/edges, but do not invalidate otherwise exact declared method views. Any production parse/encoding/declaration-span binding failure rejects the whole cohort; no favorable-only subset admission.
runtime_scope: No new compiled/probe joins. Original r7 command-phase availability remains15/16; syntax line overlap alone is not method execution or resolved call-graph proof.
implementation_boundary: D65 private-owner-directed benchmark research candidate. No ARE activation, admission, publication, release, deployment or authority change. Ontology record/selector dependencies empty.
claim_ceiling: Source-index mechanism qualification only; not runtime method binding, semantic graph, native quality, independent confirmation or superiority
open_questions: Can all canonical production source parse without missing spans, including legitimate dollar names and supplementary Unicode?
Which methods require explicit oversized-source handling before a bounded reader can receive complete method bodies?
What compiled identity/signature evidence can bind AST methods to runtime observations without treating line overlap as proof?
What stronger equal-access comparator and unexposed population can test material quality/cost improvement with sufficient headroom?
